title: Consolidation of E2E Test Helpers and JWT Token Generation
summary: The codebase is refactored to centralize duplicate JWT token generation and authentication helper functions across end-to-end tests into a single test helper module, improving maintainability and reducing code duplication.
before_state: 30+ duplicate implementations of JWT token generation and authentication helpers scattered across test files
after_state: Centralized test helper module with single source of truth for test JWT generation
